features.label: Kit type selection
features.text: Choose the Standard Strap Kit for all five body straps or the PCL Strap Kit for the counteracting strap and pad.

features.label: Trimmable hook and loop straps
features.text: Adjust the strap length for a secure and customized fit.

features.label: Easy swap installation
features.text: Unfasten and refasten straps at the frame D-rings without tools.

features.label: Built for ligament support
features.text: Designed for braces treating ACL, MCL, LCL, and PCL instabilities.

features.label: Hand wash care
features.text: Clean with mild detergent and air dry to maintain material integrity.

features.label: Accessory only
features.text: Listing includes replacement straps only, Rebound Dual ST brace frame not included.

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

measurement: Order the same size range strap kit as your Rebound Dual ST brace. XS-L fits brace sizes XS, S, M, and L, thigh circumference 15 to 22.5 in. XL-3XL fits brace sizes XL, 2XL, and 3XL, thigh circumference 22.5 to 30 in. Choose the Standard Strap Kit to replace the 5 body straps, or the PCL Strap Kit to replace or add the separate PCL counteracting strap and pad. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
